findings.title: Re‑entrancy in unstake() allows attacker to steal ether from other stakers
findings.offending_expression: (bool ok, ) = msg.sender.call{value: amount}(""); require(ok, "eth transfer failed");

patch.label: 修補已通過驗證（針對此攻擊）
patch.rationale: Moved state updates before the external call to follow checks-effects-interactions, preventing re‑entrancy attacks.

note: 已證實可攻擊的判定附可重跑的攻擊證據；其他判定都不代表合約沒有漏洞。
